posts.title: Why are Flathub downloads so slow sometimes?
posts.description: It's probably not your fault. On a cache miss, there are two things a reverse proxy (which Fastly is to us) can do. It can make the client wait until the proxy itself fetches the requested content and then serve it, with subsequent requests being served from the cache.
